integrity: For q>3 the proof uses the published dual-distance-three statement, the exact trace representation and weight classification, and a projective pencil-count identity. The q=3 case is handled separately by cyclic multiplier equivalence. A standalone verifier reconstructs representative prime-field codes and checks zero-section ranks directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the five-weight two-zero cyclic family in Hernández--Vega Theorem 6. It classifies minimal codewords by weight and counts them but does not enumerate inequivalent minimal supports or treat unrelated codes with the same ordinary weight enumerator.
title: All two-zero cyclic codes in Theorem 6 have the same covering structure
